title.zh: 取得的后果修改下一参考构造计划与实际使用
title.en: Acquired consequences revise reference construction and actual use

claim.zh: 接触与存量的一般规律（Becoming.Contacts、Becoming.Stock）给出从后果到后来使用的连接。经接触计划的归并，换计划保留每个旧选择恰当保留每个旧接触（Contacts.keeps_iff_retains）；修订规则回应每次失败，恰当下一计划含失败的地址（Contacts.answers_iff），不读失败的规则在地址无界时每个计划都漏掉某次失败（Contacts.blind_misses）；两个参考回应驱动二值通道到两个目标恰当它们不同，已安装的编码在通道改变后仍对恰当新通道在编码处与旧的一致（References.drives_iff、References.stays_iff）；有燃料的历程可执行恰当它被覆盖（Stock.feasible_iff_covered）。ReferencePlan 是其实例：燃料守恒且只从已持者汲取（balanced、draws_held、trace_conserves_of_law），修订接触每个失败的地址（propose_answers、revise_registers_failure）。在共同 Process/Trace 中，真实活动留下的失配地址修改保留的接触序列；控制器按新序列取得绑定的双参考值，检查分离后安装新记录，后续实际回应随之改变；第二次失配再次修改方法并使用新装置，全程燃料不重置（complete_history、revision_binds_plan、second_installed_choice）。新的已安装接触接回原 Through，旧选择保留直接复用 selection-under-registration-revision。对照是一般规律的失败方向：冻结的方法是不读失败的规则（frozen_blind、frozen_misses），常值参考违反 drives_iff，检查后漂移是 inverted_fails（drift_fails），燃料不足是未被覆盖的历程，擦除的失配不能启动（erased_mismatch_cannot_activate）。
claim.en: The general laws of contacts and stock (Becoming.Contacts, Becoming.Stock) carry the connection from consequence to later use. With the lumping through a contact plan, a change of plan keeps every old selection exactly where it retains every old contact (Contacts.keeps_iff_retains); a revision rule answers every failure exactly where it puts the failed address into the next plan (Contacts.answers_iff), and a rule that does not read failures leaves some failure unanswered at every plan once addresses are unbounded (Contacts.blind_misses); two reference responses drive a two-valued channel to both targets exactly when they differ, and an installed encoding stays right exactly where the new channel agrees with the old at the encoded inputs (References.drives_iff, References.stays_iff); a fuelled course is executable exactly where it is covered (Stock.feasible_iff_covered). ReferencePlan is an instance: its fuel is conserved and drawn only from what is held (balanced, draws_held, trace_conserves_of_law), and its revision contacts every failed address (propose_answers, revise_registers_failure). Within the shared Process/Trace, an acquired mismatch address revises a retained contact sequence; the controller executes it, acquires bound reference pairs, checks separation, installs fresh records and changes actual later response; a second mismatch revises the method again without resetting fuel (complete_history, revision_binds_plan, second_installed_choice). New installed contacts reuse Through and old-choice preservation directly reuses selection-under-registration-revision. The controls are failure directions of the general laws: the frozen method is a rule that does not read failures (frozen_blind, frozen_misses), constant references fail drives_iff, post-check drift is inverted_fails (drift_fails), insufficient fuel is an uncovered course, and an erased mismatch cannot activate (erased_mismatch_cannot_activate).

hypotheses.zh: 给定可寻址的二值接触原语、目标及普通任务顺序、可靠实际回返、两参考的地址绑定及检查到使用间的稳定对应。
hypotheses.en: Supplied addressed Boolean contacts, targets and ordinary undertaking order, faithful actual return, bound reference pairs and stable correspondence between checking and use.

hypotheses.zh: 修订律把取得的失败地址接入旧接触序列开头；检查律要求每对参考分离，装配及留存可执行。原语与修订／检查律的自身取得没有被假定已解释。
hypotheses.en: The revision rule prepends an acquired failed address to the retained sequence; checking requires each reference pair to separate, with operative assembly and retention. Formation of those primitives and revision/check rules is not claimed explained.

hypotheses.zh: 每次普通操作用去 1 单位燃料、每对参考 2 单位；每步须被所持燃料覆盖。见证从 30 开始，无补给；不是通用物理量或分子材料存量。
hypotheses.en: Each ordinary operation uses one unit of fuel and each reference pair two; every step must be covered by the fuel held. The witness starts with 30 and has no replenishment; these are not universal physical amounts or molecular stocks.

hypotheses.zh: 新增候选相对于当前接触计划及装置；可用原语和地址空间仍属于给定总律。归并的等价针对装置已安装的接触域，实际编码与使用另行检查。 普通活动回返属于整体的另一实际关系；不把已安装参考域当作系统全部接触。漂移是同一过程内给定、用去燃料的原语。
hypotheses.en: Candidate novelty is relative to the current contact plan and apparatus; primitives and address space remain in the supplied encompassing law. The lumping concerns installed contacts, with actual encoding and use checked separately. Ordinary return is another actual relationship within the whole; the lumping through installed references is not total system access. Drift is an admitted primitive of the same process that uses fuel.

correspondence.zh: 活动、回返、方法、装置、支持和回应是同一关系展开内的分化作用。P99 是共享主干的新实例；既有查询选择、方法形成、校准和传递成果被信用，不冒充所有旧化学／网络模型的同历史形式拼接。固定总律不取消内部方法修改，也不消除其科学前提。
correspondence.en: Activity, return, method, apparatus, support and response are differentiated roles within one unfolding. P99 is a new shared-spine instance. Existing inquiry, method-formation, calibration and transmission results are credited, not claimed formally concatenated across all older chemical/network models. A fixed encompassing law does not erase internal method change or discharge scientific premises.

detail.zh: frozen_second_method_still_fails 保留第一修复及更多燃料，却不能处理第二失配，是不读失败的规则在每个计划都漏掉某次失败（frozen_misses）的一例；erased_mismatch_cannot_activate、support_too_small_to_build、constant_channel_rejected 与 drift_after_check_can_fail 保留失配记录、燃料、可分性及稳定范围的失败，后两者是 drives_iff 与 inverted_fails 的失败方向（drift_fails）。drift_has_actual_history 给出检查后的漂移和失败的同一 Trace，不只替换对照起始配置。
detail.en: frozen_second_method_still_fails retains the first repair and more fuel yet misses the second mismatch, a case of the law that a rule blind to failures misses one at every plan (frozen_misses); erased_mismatch_cannot_activate, support_too_small_to_build, constant_channel_rejected and drift_after_check_can_fail preserve failures of the mismatch record, fuel, separation and stability, the last two as failure directions of drives_iff and inverted_fails (drift_fails). drift_has_actual_history gives a shared Trace for post-check drift and failure, rather than only changing the control’s starting configuration.

limitations.zh: 完成有条件的局部方法—参考—装置—使用接口，未推导任意新感知原语、修订编译器的自身取得、所有普通任务的自主选择、真实接触可靠性、通用吸引／盆地、规范正当性或无实质前提基础。有限见证不是普遍可纠正性；旧材料模型的正式组合仍未新增。
limitations.en: Completes a conditional local method–reference–apparatus–use interface, without deriving arbitrary sensing primitives, acquisition of the revision compiler, autonomous selection of all ordinary tasks, actual contact reliability, general attraction/basins, normative warrant or a premise-free foundation. The finite witness is not universal corrigibility; no new formal composition of older material models is claimed.
